def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # A uniform row or column divides the two patterns.
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h)
                    if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        divider = grid[sep_row][0]
        left = grid[:sep_row]
        other = grid[sep_row + 1:]
        other_vals = [x for row in other for x in row if x != divider]
        bg = max(set(other_vals), key=other_vals.count) if other_vals else 7
        marks = {x for row in left for x in row if x != divider and x != bg}
        return [[3 if x in marks else bg for x in row] for row in left]

    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        divider = grid[0][sep_col]
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        other_vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(sep_col + 1, w)
                      if grid[r][c] != divider]
        bg = max(set(other_vals), key=other_vals.count) if other_vals else 8
        marks = {x for row in left for x in row if x != divider and x != bg}
        return [[3 if x in marks else bg for x in row] for row in left]

    return grid

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The 2s form the divider; compare corresponding cells in the panels.
    c = next(j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 2 for i in range(h)))
